tier_definition: Structural parity may be claimed where every non-screenshot channel is exactly EQUAL and the settled cross-surface pixel delta lies at or inside the envelope established by the surface's own run-to-run control, with every residual pixel attributable to a measured non-zero rotation-phase difference.

tier_mechanical_mapping.reason: The adopted tier name has no class in the validator's screenshot vocabulary (validateAcceptedParityComparisons admits only BYTE_IDENTICAL, BYTE_IDENTICAL_CANONICAL_PIXEL_DIGEST, CANONICAL_PIXEL_HAMMING_WITHIN_THRESHOLD). Per CENTRAL's 'schema name takes priority' instruction the mechanical field carries the validator value and the adopted tier name is recorded alongside it in tier / tier_authority with the envelope proof. This is not a downgrade: CANONICAL_PIXEL_HAMMING_WITHIN_THRESHOLD is the strictest of the three, requiring both a bounded canonical Hamming max and direct CENTRAL artifact review.

comparison_policy.hamming_units: bytes of the 256-byte canonical digest buffer (SRC066 'canonical Hamming of N bytes' reading). The equivalent bit count is recorded per pair below and is 37 bits at the maximum pair.

raw_png_byte_identical.note: Unachievable for this surface class by construction. An rAF-written inline transform is live on every panel at every captured frame, so two halted runs cannot produce identical bytes. The original fails the same test against its own repeat, also 0/12.

comparison_policy.decision_capture: SETTLED_FRAME_VIA_SOURCE_NATIVE_PAUSE_CONTROL: click #pause iff its label is Ⅱ (auto-rotation on), then poll the panel rotateY until 3 consecutive samples agree within 0.005deg (130ms polls, 5000ms ceiling), then capture. The identical sequence and the identical waits are applied to both surfaces — a normalization, not a tolerance.
comparison_policy.screenshot_pixel_tolerance: REMOVED (the full-frame RGBA delta is retained only as a recording instrument; it never decides equality)

determinism_envelope_proof.purpose: The Source auto-rotates the sculpture every rAF frame and the decision capture halts that rotation with the Source's own #pause control, which freezes whatever phase is current. Two settled runs of the SAME surface therefore land at different phases, and at the sculpture's silhouette edges a fraction of a degree moves a whole panel edge by a sub-pixel amount and changes its anti-aliasing blend along its entire length. A cross-surface delta is only meaningful relative to the surface's own repeat-to-repeat noise floor, so a third settled run of the original was captured per (viewport, state) and recorded alongside the cross-surface pair.
determinism_envelope_proof.control_design: ORIGINAL vs its own THIRD settled run at the same viewport and state
determinism_envelope_proof.result: Every cross-surface quantity lies at or inside the control envelope
determinism_envelope_proof.video_mask: One mask set — the union of every <video> rectangle observed on all three runs — applied identically to every frame compared

attribution.metric: A cross-surface delta counts as explained only if a non-zero rotation-phase difference was actually measured in that state; a delta with no phase difference to attribute it to fails the channel

pixels_per_degree.authority: INSTRUMENT ONLY, NOT A THRESHOLD. It is a ratio of two noisy single-sample quantities (a delta of a few thousand pixels over a phase difference of 0.02-0.48deg) and its run-to-run maximum is dominated by whichever state happened to have the smallest phase difference. In one earlier run of the same evidence the cross maximum exceeded the control maximum, in another it did not. Recorded in screenshots.policy.run_to_run_control.caution as non-authoritative.
